ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its tables. The parts reach these tables only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.ingest-parts owns them (user 2026-10-23: Ingest SubClip).

rules.part: A part is frames in_frame..out_frame of a clip of the catalog (OUT is the bound after its last picture), inside the clip's stored length, read through qnc-content-read; it is the instruction of what the import copies, not a Story SubClip.
rules.identity: A part id is <clip_id>-part-NN from a counter per clip that only grows: an id is never used again.
rules.import: Uvezi cuts every ticked part not cut yet (selected, new parts ticked; cut_name empty) from the original (MXF by qnc-mxf-cut, MP4 and QuickTime by qnc-mp4-cut, one second of handles, from the intra picture at or before them) onto the parts card in the project folder products.subclips (SubClip/<card label>_<serial>/, the original card layout; Sony documents by qnc-sony-card-write), records its file name in cut_name, selects that card like any card and queues its clips, which are linked where they are; a clip with parts is not imported whole (qnc-content-store FinishAsParts).
